extra_quotes: We epitaxially grew uniform CrSb films on S TO(001) substrates by MBE, with experimental details provided in the Methods section.
Electrical transport and magnetic characterizations were measured by Physical Property Measurement System (PPMS) from Quantum Design integrated with a Vibrating Sample Magnetometer (VSM).
DFT calculations for CrSb were performed using the VASP by employing the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof (PBE) generalized gradient approximation (GGA) for exchange-correlation functional

While the saturation magnetic moment exhibits slight sample‑to‑sample variation, a common feature of ultrathin epitaxial films due to inherent thickness and coverage fluctuations, the characteristic hysteresis loop remains fully reproducible across all measured samples.
